deployments_detail.use: 'Aida' voice-enabled mobile assistant for 400+ tied insurance agents (Swiss Life France) providing hands-free voice queries of client data, note dictation, geolocated client suggestions and data-science-driven leads. From PoC to MVP in 3 months; in production 6+ months, ~10 uses/day per agent. [Google Cloud (Cloud Speech-to-Text, Dialogflow Enterprise, Vision AI, GKE) with partner Quantmetry]

Machine-learning client-experience scoring and knowledge engine augmenting ~800 sales representatives at Swiss Life France, using semantic analysis of unstructured data to better understand client needs (life insurance, retirement, benefits) and prioritize interactions. [Swiss Life France data science division with Quantmetry]

Outbound AI voicebot (LLM-enhanced) fully handling customer outreach and meeting scheduling / lead generation, replacing part-time call-center operators. In operation over one year, handling 100% of the outbound calls in scope. [Daktela (CCaaS platform with LLM voicebot)]
deployments_detail.value: 70% reduction in outbound call costs; 100% of calls handled by bot; 7% sales success rate comparable to human operators

deployments_detail.use: AI phone bot replacing legacy touch-tone IVR to route inbound customer calls via natural-language intent recognition and direct callers to the right advisor/expert. Launched as pilot in one sales division at Swiss Life Germany, then rolled out across all four sales departments. [Parloa (conversational AI platform), implemented with consultancy MUUUH!]
deployments_detail.value: 96% routing accuracy; 60% faster call resolution; 73% of respondents rated agent 4-5/5

deployments_detail.use: Conversational AI phonebots deployed in both customer service and sales-partner (Vertriebspartner) service centers to relieve staff, reduce costs and improve reachability/customer experience. Described as running for 3+ years. [CAIB (Conversational AI consultancy) with Swiss Life]

AI agent debuted at the Swiss Life Network Partners Conference in London (Sep 2025); described as milestone/showcase rather than confirmed production. [Swiss Life Deutschland (custom-built AI assistant; underlying model not disclosed)]

AI-powered compliance call/meeting recording and speech analytics in Microsoft Teams: automatic conversation classification, topic recognition, speech-to-text transcription and analysis to simplify case processing and compliance. [ASC Technologies 'Recording Insights' on Microsoft Teams / Azure AI Services]

Use of GitHub Copilot / AI coding agents by Swiss Life software engineers to improve developer productivity, code quality and delivery; Swiss Life participated in a Microsoft Switzerland panel testifying that these changes are 'bringing real value.'
